rfq.faq1a: Our standard response time is within 4 business hours for all RFQs. For emergency requests marked as Same Day, our dedicated team activates within 30 minutes and maintains contact until delivery is confirmed.
rfq.faq2a: Every listing states the condition grade — new, refurbished, used, or surplus — and the part identity (brand, model, part number or IMPA code) recorded by our team. Most of our stock is used or surplus equipment that we inspect and describe as accurately as possible; these items are sold as inspected and are not covered by a manufacturer warranty, as set out in our Terms of Service. Where the supplier provides a certificate of conformity, test report, or material certificate, it accompanies the item and is listed in the quotation — certificates are not automatic for every shipment. Ask for any document you need before ordering and we will tell you whether it is available.
rfq.faq3a: Yes. Our emergency procurement line operates 24/7. We maintain strategic inventory for critical-path deliveries from our Bhavnagar hub. We've successfully fulfilled emergency orders within 18 hours of RFQ submission.
rfq.faq4q: What regions do you ship to?
rfq.faq4a: We operate in 50+ countries across all major maritime routes and industrial corridors. Our primary hubs cover Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Europe, Africa, and the Americas. We handle all customs documentation, export licensing, and freight logistics.
